I want to convert all facts into parentless partial order edges labeled "ancestor of" to derive possible chains.**Evaluating intersection paths**

I’ll systematically map all edges to check for nodes with two parents or children. It looks like there’s no cyclic connection between Grace and James, so that’s good!
